ideas.pitch: An autonomous agricultural rover that maps soil moisture anomalies using edge ML and executes targeted micro-irrigation.
ideas.title: AgriSense: Autonomous Crop Health and Variable-Rate Irrigation Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a published physical track using an autonomous rover hardware build, combining edge IoT telemetry with physical actuation—mirroring successful physical robotics setups like the Quanta 2025 winner.

ideas.pitch: A localized Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) controlled by an LLM-driven multi-agent navigation system that optimizes warehouse inventory scans.
ideas.title: AuraGrid: Multi-Agent Warehouse Inventory and Obstacle-Avoiding AGV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines advanced embodied task planning with a physical chassis, heavily leveraging the proven patterns of autonomous task planners and physical robotics builds.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled physical water flow gate system running anomaly detection models locally to dynamically regulate water retention and prevent urban flooding.
ideas.title: AquaFlow: Edge-AI Autonomous Sluice Gate Control for Flood and Water Management
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical infrastructure with a tangible closed-loop hardware setup, incorporating edge anomaly detection similar to top-placing IoT diagnostic tools.

ideas.pitch: A low-cost desktop robotic arm equipped with real-time computer vision to segregate complex multi-material waste streams for sustainable manufacturing.
ideas.title: EcoSort: Edge-Vision Robotic Arm for Recyclable Sorting and Green Tech
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a working live demo of computer vision classification paired with physical robotic actuation, directly echoing the proven success of AI-powered garbage and object sorting builds.

ideas.pitch: A robust physical mesh-networked rover and drone pairing that utilizes edge sensor fusion to map hazardous rubble zones where GPS fails.
ideas.title: DisasterScout: Semi-Autonomous Teleoperated Drone and Rover Swarm for Search & Rescue
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-stakes emergency track with genuine hard engineering in wireless telemetry and physical mobility, standing out sharply against software-only concepts.
